paragraphs: I'm Asha Rao. I work on AI and internal tools at Alt Carbon, a company that removes carbon dioxide from the air by spreading crushed basalt on farmland.

Most of my work is making software that people who don't care about software can use without help. At the moment that means The Portfolio Project: every colleague gets a personal site they can edit themselves and take with them when they leave.
I like websites that are small, fast and made of text. This one is my argument for them.

experience.summary: AI and internal tools for field, lab and carbon accounting teams.
Offline data collection apps for agricultural surveys.
Rainfall and crop yield models for insurers.

contact: Email is best: [asha@example.com](mailto:asha@example.com). I answer most things within a week. I'm always glad to hear from people building small tools for field teams.
shortBio: Asha Rao builds AI and internal tools at Alt Carbon, an enhanced rock weathering company in India. Current project: a portable personal website for every employee.
